verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Ollama serves models that users chat with, and that it connects to external agents such as Claude Code and OpenClaw. Nothing shows Ollama itself being operated or managed through natural-language commands: model pull, rm and run are CLI commands, and the conversational assistants are separate tools. Chatting with a hosted model and third-party agent integrations are adjacent features, not natural-language control of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
